packageRules.description: The plugin must build against the loft vcluster SDK, which pins the k8s libraries: vcluster v0.37.2 requires k8s.io/* 0.36 and does not build with 0.37 (apiserver/component-helpers 0.36 break, vcluster authorizers lack ConditionsAwareAuthorize, etcd 3.6.8 snapshot API). Hold k8s.io/* below 0.37 until a vcluster release moves to 0.37, then raise this cap in the same change.

controller-runtime is pinned to the pseudo-version the vcluster SDK requires (go mod resolves it from github.com/loft-sh/vcluster). Bumping it independently breaks the build; it moves only with a vcluster bump.
